summary: This video gives a first look at Season 9 on the Chinese server, highlighting new content and system updates. It reviews the S9 element affinities pairing Lightning with Fire, Ice with Radiant, and Poison with Necrosis alongside corresponding Psychicore talent tree options. The creator previews new S9 heroes including Theodemer and Torrin, tests summons on new banners, and checks refreshed shops, noting the inclusion of pet skill scrolls in the Pact Shop. Finally, the S9 Battle Pass featuring a new skin for Saverio is showcased.

meta_changes: Season 9 element affinities pair Lightning with Fire, Ice with Radiant, and Poison with Necrosis.
Psychicore talent trees updated with new tier VII/VIII nodes granting element-specific attack and damage reduction buffs.
Pact Shop in S9 now includes normal and legendary familiar/pet skill scroll option chests.
